title: OT/ICS Security Engineer
summary: An OT/ICS security engineer protects the computers and networks that run factories, power plants and utilities, such as PLCs (programmable logic controllers) and SCADA (supervisory control) systems. They sit in a cybersecurity or plant engineering team and work with control engineers so that security changes never stop production.
dailyDuties: Review OT network alerts from monitoring tools such as Nozomi or Claroty
Keep the inventory of PLCs, HMIs and servers up to date
Design firewall rules and segmentation between plant and corporate networks
Run risk assessments against IEC 62443 for a plant or site
Plan patching and OT-safe vulnerability scans around shutdowns
Approve and monitor secure remote access for vendors
Explain security changes to plant operators and control engineers

skills.expectation: Apply IEC 62443 and the Purdue model to secure plant networks and control systems
Understand how PLCs, SCADA, DCS and HMIs work and talk to each other on the plant floor
Design and maintain firewalls, industrial DMZs and zone-and-conduit segmentation
Run OT risk assessments and gap assessments against IEC 62443 or NIST 800-82
Find and fix vulnerabilities in OT assets with OT-safe scanning and planned patching
Monitor OT network alerts from tools such as Nozomi, Claroty or Dragos and escalate anomalies
Explain security changes to plant operators, control engineers and IT teams
Configure VLANs and switches on control networks
Support OT incident response plans and tabletop exercises
Map controls to NIST CSF or ISO 27001 alongside IEC 62443
Control secure remote access and accounts for vendors and engineers
Harden Windows servers that run HMIs, historians and engineering workstations
Automate asset inventory and reporting tasks

certifications.why: Security fundamentals for engineers coming from controls or networking
Networking basics for segmenting plant networks
Broad security credential asked for in senior OT roles
The certification most often named as a plus in Indian OT security postings.
IEC 62443 is asked for in almost every OT security posting, and this is ISA's first certificate.
